description: A function call in parentheses is not a static call
notes: The spec makes function call syntax a static call without saying whether parentheses around it, which only group in evaluation, keep it one. hashicorp/hcl keeps the parentheses as a ParenthesesExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), which has no ExprCall method and can't be unwrapped, so hcl.ExprCall reports an error.
reference_error: A static function call is required
